rho_k =  870. # kg / m3 - wood density
rho_f = 1000. # kg / m3 - water density
g = 9.81      # N / kg - gravitational acceleration
b_x = 1.5     # m - box width
b_y = 2.0     # m - box length
h = 1.5       # m - box height
w = 0.01      # m - wall thickness
F_g = \rho_k \cdot g \cdot V_k = \rho_k \cdot g \cdot \left[b_x \cdot b_y \cdot h - \left(h - w\right) \cdot  \left(b_x - 2 w\right) \cdot \left(b_y - 2 w\right)\right]
children.html: Fg=ρk⋅g⋅Vk=ρk⋅g⋅[bx⋅by⋅h−(h−w)⋅(bx−2w)⋅(by−2w)] F_g = \rho_k \cdot g \cdot V_k = \rho_k \cdot g \cdot \left[b_x \cdot b_y \cdot h - \left(h - w\right) \cdot \left(b_x - 2 w\right) \cdot \left(b_y - 2 w\right)\right] Fg​=ρk​⋅g⋅Vk​=ρk​⋅g⋅[bx​⋅by​⋅h−(h−w)⋅(bx​−2w)⋅(by​−2w)]

children.value:
V_k = b_x * b_y * h - (b_x - 2 * w) * (b_y - 2 * w) * (h - w)
F_g = V_k * rho_k * g
print(f'Body volume V_k = {V_k:.2f} m3\nWeight force: {F_g:.2f} N')

children.html: Vv=Fg/(ρf⋅g) V_v = F_g / \left(\rho_f \cdot g \right) Vv​=Fg​/(ρf​⋅g)

children.value:
V_v = F_g / (rho_f * g)
print(f'Displaced volume: {V_v:.2f} m3')

children.html: d=Vv/(bx⋅by) d = V_v / \left(b_x \cdot b_y\right) d=Vv​/(bx​⋅by​)
f=h−d f = h - d f=h−d

children.value:
d = V_v / b_x * b_y
f = h - d
print(f'Draft d = {d:.2f} m\nFreeboard f = {f:.2f} m')
if f >= 0:
    print("The body floats.")
if f < 0:
    print("The body sinks.")

V_k_side_walls = 2 * (b_y - 2 * w) * (h - w) * w
V_k_front_back = 2 * b_x * (h - w) * w
V_k_bottom = b_x * b_y * w
h_g = ((V_k_side_walls + V_k_front_back) * (w + h / 2) + V_k_bottom * w / 2) / V_k
print(f'h_g = {h_g:.2f} m')
